**Main-red anchor card.** Filed by triage. ⛔ Not a claim. p0: `main` is red.

## Reading

- **Red on `main`:** the CI run's `Dogfood Regression Gate` failed on two consecutive heads:
  - `dfbe34d8`, the landing of PR #29365, [run 41457302278](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41457302278);
  - `7f277a86`, [run 41458677191](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41458677191).
- **Last green:** the head before it, `925e8607`.
- **The same two files fail on both heads, so the failure is deterministic:**
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-runas.dogfood.test.ts`: 3 cases. A member-triggered `/automation/…` call now answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` where the file expects 200, or 400 `FLOW_FAILED`.
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/declarative-endpoint-anonymous-guest.dogfood.test.ts`: 1 case (`expected [] to have a length of 1`).
- **Why the queue let it through:** the dogfood shards are `skipped` on PRs and in the merge queue, so CI never ran either file before the landing.
- **Breaking PR:** #29365 (`fix(runtime): every flow start door judges a start input against the object the flow's definition reads it from`), landed by `domain:server#5`.

## Wanted (stop-bleed)

The landing seat makes `main` green with one validated PR. Before pushing, run both dogfood files locally.

- If the two files hold expectations that #29365's ruled scope deliberately changes, re-point the expectations and say so in the PR.
- If they show a case #29365 should not have changed, fix the door.
- ⛔ No revert of #29365 without the maintainer: it is part of ruled work.
- Whether a start-input check or a test expectation is right is a security-boundary question. Take it to the maintainer through the pm-dispatch channel, never on this card.

Reader who acts: `domain:server#5`, which landed it, then any `domain:server` seat.
